summary_en: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group authorized acquisition of up to 45.0 million shares (1.6% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 50.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 13, 2026 to March 31, 2027. All acquired shares will be retired on April 19, 2027. The buyback aims to improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Determination of Matters Related to Retirement of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group's board of directors resolved on November 12, 2026 to acquire up to 45.0 million shares of its common stock, representing 1.6% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum expenditure of 50.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 13, 2026 and March 31, 2027, with no price ceiling specified in the disclosure.

All shares acquired under this program will be retired effective April 19, 2027. The company stated that the buyback aims to improve capital efficiency, taking into account its capital adequacy requirements, capital deployment for medium- to long-term profit growth, and current stock price levels. This buyback is positioned as part of the company's stated shareholder return policy adopted in May 2026, which targets a total return payout ratio of at least 50% and describes treasury share acquisition as a flexible return measure to be implemented based on business performance, capital situation, and stock price movements.
